items.quote: A broad trend line will be around the current run rates of around 23%
items.statement: General merchandise and apparel (GMA) share trend line of around 23%

items.quote: typically 10% to 15% of my number count should be my new store opening, broadly

items.quote: whatever we do today, 14%-15% gross margin, we're going to play around that
